title: The Hrunting of AI: Where and How to Improve English Dialectal Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Transcreating task-specific prompts from standard American English into multiple English dialects (AAVE, Yorkshire, Geordie, Cornish) and West Frisian. The study evaluates LLM generation quality and LLM-as-a-judge performance by comparing human-annotated rubric scores (assessing locale adherence, grammar, and correctness) with model evaluations.

Using a specific rubric criterion to evaluate whether LLM-generated responses are culturally accurate for the target locale, such as using the correct customary measurement units (e.g., feet vs. metres or pounds vs. kilograms) and ensuring argument appropriateness.
